what: Every pinned try-compile row was keyed with `--target aarch64-apple-darwin` in its arguments and the target again from the host, so a macro-side probe for wasm32-wasip1 (thiserror, rustix, proc-macro2) never found its row and tempo's check stopped on CannotAnswerYet.
cost: three CannotAnswerYet stops on tempo's check, each read as a missing row
cause: the key held the target twice, once as written in the row's arguments and once as the side's triple
fix: probe_ask::Compile::key keys the target once (its --target, else the host); rows name no --target and are made per side
